resources.string: Every tape is different. Start gently and compare with the original while the music keeps playing.
Rumble reduces very low bass. Clarity also gently reduces low-mid buildup, without boosting treble or tape hiss.

Applies to music played on this device, including downloads. Cast receivers use the original audio. Your saved recordings stay unchanged.\n\nThis is gentle tone correction. It cannot recover detail lost to distortion or reliably remove the crowd. Enhancement may sound slightly quieter; louder is not always better.
Mix the processed audio with the original recording.
